description: Derived extract of Experiment 011's recorded per-component fractions (f_k for the 18 components of layers 1–2, f_E, f_total, f_layers, q_T) per (token, frame), normalized by the plural cue's measured head change (null where the frame was uninformative for the token). Experiment 012 recomputes these and requires agreement within 1e-6.
